name: @origin-labs-ai/dsh-enhanced

scripts.build: tsdown && echo 'Build complete - copying extra modules...' && mkdir -p lib && cp lib/types/index.js lib/index.js 2>/dev/null || true && cp lib/types/invariant.js lib/invariant.js 2>/dev/null || true && cp lib/types/startup.js lib/startup.js 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build:full: tsdown && echo 'Building all modules...' && tsc --project tsconfig.json --outDir lib
